project-rhymemosaic.description: The public poetry reading room combines reading paths, a browser-local queue and a language-practice notebook. The current release record reports v42; literary sources and publication permissions remain separate from interface changes.
project-rhymemosaic.dateLabel: Public route checked; v42 release record reviewed

project-hydra-index.description: An evidence-conscious compound and research reference. Its current public health endpoint reports release 67529258 ready. Source-linked study reading, the Observatory and research discovery remain its central public routes.

project-threads-observatory.description: An owner-only creative studio for post-performance history, source-linked word and poetry intake, and editorial queue review. The current site record reports v15. Private content and publishing approval remain separate.

project-resonance-atlas-synchronicity.description: An owner-only workspace for recording coincidences, examining patterns and comparing interpretations. Its current site record reports v9. Recorded experiences are not treated as proof of causality.

project-public-deception-atlas.description: An owner-only source-linked research project about public claims, documented misrepresentation and counterevidence. The current site record reports v15; its private case material is not exposed through this directory.

project-forge-lexicon.description: The language-development pipeline keeps experiments, exact usage witnesses and reviewed definitions distinct. A new private reconciliation preserves existing public terms and definition history while collecting recent candidates without automatic publication.

project-brandonmeant.description: One half of the poetry diptych. A full-reader proof is undergoing text-extraction, layout and accessibility review; author approval, retailer checks and a verified commercial release remain separate.

project-the-wreckage-arranged-me.description: The companion poetry collection remains in private proof review. Revised reader and print files are distinguished from historical text witnesses and from a verified retail publication.

project-sanford-resource-hub.description: A public, mobile-oriented guide to local support in Sanford and Lee County: meals, essential services, contacts, maps and practical planning. Provider availability should still be confirmed before travel.

project-techenlight.description: Public technology services covering device troubleshooting, websites, practical AI and one-to-one tutoring. A direct way to explore service scope and contact the person doing the work.

concepts.name: Sacred Interval · Church of Dissociation

concepts.name: DAB-1 · Prompting Benchmark
concepts.description: A retained prompting-comparison experiment with prepared pilot materials. No completed empirical run, measured advantage or validated outcome is claimed.

concepts.name: Eliminating Loneliness · Teaching Pilot
concepts.description: A retained teaching and connection-oriented pilot idea. Lesson recovery and a small, testable pilot would precede any claim of delivery or demonstrated benefit.

concepts.name: Burrit’o’clock
concepts.description: A playful product idea kept in the speculative backlog. Its presence here records an idea worth retaining, not an available product or a promise to build it.

concepts.name: Public-interest Creative & Technical Lab
concepts.description: A possible supporter-funded framework for documented creative and technical work. Funding, institutional status, staffing and delivered fellowships are not established.
